# CF-001: Cloudflare Tunnel presence

- **Group:** Cloudflare Tunnel
- **Severity when it fails:** info
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Whether a cloudflared connector runs decides which ingress profile fits the host (tunnel or not) and which other checks apply. Connectors are found as processes, so containerised connectors count without the Docker API; with it, running cloudflared containers count too, which covers hosts that hide other users' processes.

## Verify by hand

```sh
pgrep -a cloudflared; systemctl status cloudflared
```

## How to fix it

Nothing to fix; this records the tunnel for profile inference

Run `stackward explain CF-001` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
